title: Swedish Housing Law Praxis Layer
purpose: Source-attributed precedent layer for QCDS legal assessment. Decisions are competing interpretive evidence, not automatic statutory rules. Court authority, factual similarity and outcome remain separate dimensions.

authority_scale.note: Authority weight describes source status only. QCDS precedent relevance is similarity/counter-factor assessment; a lower-authority decision can be factually close without outranking an HD precedent as a source of law.

precedents.name: Lokalerna i Gulddragaren
principles: Whether an apartment is a residential or commercial tenancy depends on the purpose for which it was let, not merely on labels.
Classification under Chapter 12 can itself be an interpretive question requiring an overall assessment.

precedents.name: Lägenheten i Fältskären
principles: A legal barrier to using a dwelling can constitute hindrance or detriment even when the physical apartment has been presented as ready for occupation.
Assessment of defects can include legal usability, not only physical condition.

precedents.name: Brandskadan i asyllägenheten
principles: Responsibility under Chapter 12 can turn on the legal character of another person's use of the dwelling and the tenant's relationship to that use.
Second-hand and independently exercised use can create assessment questions beyond the existence of a simple contractual label.

precedents.name: Entré Malmö
principles: Hindrance or detriment in the right of use may support rent reduction and, when sufficiently serious, early termination.
Materiality is an assessment of the concrete impact of the defect on the agreed use.

precedents.name: NJA 2011 s. 454
principles: Contractual or house-rule language does not by itself settle statutory liability; negligence and the statutory responsibility framework must be assessed.
A contractual term can be legally relevant without being dispositive of the statutory question.

precedents.name: Kylbaffeln
principles: A tenant does not have a separate general duty to make a legal reclamation in order to preserve claims arising from a defect in the right of use.
The statutory notice duties and the special structure of tenancy law matter when general contract-law principles are considered.

precedents.name: Bergrumsgaraget
principles: Whether an underground space is a house for Chapter 12 purposes depends on its design and function, not only ordinary-language labels.
The material meaning and intended use of the agreement can be relevant when deciding whether an arrangement is tenancy.

precedents.name: Inneboende under frihetsberövande
principles: An arrangement described as lodging can amount to independent second-hand use when the principal tenant is absent for a sufficiently material period.
The legal classification depends on the actual use, not only the parties' label.

precedents.name: Otillåten andrahandsupplåtelse under knappt två månader
principles: An unauthorized second-hand letting lasting less than two months was, on the facts of that case, not of merely minor significance.
The minor-significance safeguard is an evaluative question rather than a fixed duration threshold.

precedents.name: Brister och bevisbörda
principles: The landlord generally bears the burden of showing that a defect arising during the tenancy was caused by the tenant, with evidential presumptions possible for damage of a type typically caused by carelessness in tenant-controlled areas.
Legal outcome can therefore depend on evidence structure as well as substantive defect rules.

precedents.name: Återbetalning av andrahandshyra
principles: Assessment of second-hand rent can require attention to the first-hand rent and the actual proportion of the apartment that was sublet.
Repayment questions can involve both substantive rent ceilings and procedural/claim-holder issues.

precedents.name: Större ombyggnad och förlängning
principles: A major renovation does not automatically defeat the tenant's extension right; the reasonableness assessment can include the practical and economic suitability of replacement housing.
The balancing exercise is concrete and fact-sensitive.

precedents.name: Vilken privatupplåtelse var den första?
statutory_links: 1 § lagen (2012:978) om uthyrning av egen bostad
principles: Under the legacy private-letting law, the relevant letting occurred through the agreement itself rather than only when physical access began.
Temporal classification can therefore turn on contract formation rather than move-in date.
